one_liner: Built civic-letter product; not investible until operator validates demand, compliance, and delivery trust.

killCriteria: Fewer than 20 paid concierge campaigns by 2026-08-31 [assumption].

decision: Do not approve as a business yet; run validation or keep as research asset.
